example.title: Ben Bonderson Farm, drive-in crib barn

brief: Drive-in double corn crib painted barn red with white corner boards and verge trim: two slatted crib bays with diagonal ventilation slats flank a tall central driveway open through the building, with a plank loft above and a square cupola-like elevator housing rising from the rear of the ridge. A lower gable-roofed side bin with a small white window adjoins at right; wood-shingle roofs. Behind it a long red cow shed with a grey metal roof and white windows, board fences and cattle panels around the yard, a steel grain bin at the corner.
